programme.desc: An American anthropologist (Richard Mulligan) and his son (John Philip Hogdon) are improved by their exposure to an East African tribe. - 1974

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: The son (Edwin Mahinda) of a priest slain by Mau Mau moves in with a police officer (Bob Peck) and his wife (Phyllis Logan) in 1950 Kenya. - 1987

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: A streetwalker (Eartha Kitt) falls in love after her family marries her off for money. - 1958

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.). (Drama) - 1969

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs. (Drama) - 1972

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life. (Drama) - 1974

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them. (Drama) - 1987

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult. (Drama) - 1958

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money. (Crime drama) - 1972

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily. (Action) - 1974

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans. (Drama) - 1976

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (Crime drama) - 1975

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall. (Action, Comedy, Crime drama) - 1976

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: A lawless frontier town, plagued by bandits, hires a notorious Mexican gunfighter to serve as its new sheriff. - 1956

programme.title: Bat Masterson - The Court Martial of Major Mars
programme.desc: At Crazy Creek Station, an Indian and his gang take Bat, Major Mars and Lottie Tremaine hostage to exact revenge upon Mars for a number of crimes he committed against Indians.

programme.title: Bat Masterson - The Price of Paradise
programme.desc: The owner of a casino in Paradise, Colo., refuses to pay the debts and taxes he owes, prompting Bat's appointment to the role of county tax assessor.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory - Doc Holliday in Durango
programme.desc: Sheriff Hollister goes after an outlaw who is looking for revenge for his brother's death.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory - Triangle of Death
programme.desc: A con man and his sister hatch a plan to distract Sheriff Hollister while they rob a bank.

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States. - 1961

programme.title: Overland Pacific
programme.desc: A railroad agent takes an assumed identity to investigate several Indian raids. - 1954

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: A cattle baron (Gene Hackman) with a long-range rifle hunts the outlaw (Oliver Reed) who has kidnapped his wife (Candice Bergen). - 1971

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy. - 1959

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: A town boss hires a gunslinger (Yul Brynner) to kill an outcast (George Segal), then hires the outcast to kill the gunslinger. - 1964

programme.desc: A gunslinger (Buster Crabbe) goes after the land baron (Barton MacLane) who framed and killed his brother. - 1960

programme.title: The King and Four Queens
programme.desc: A drifter (Clark Gable) finds hidden gold in a town where a woman (Jo Van Fleet) lives with the wives of her bank-robber sons. - 1956

programme.title: Tombstone Territory - Pick Up the Gun
programme.desc: Billy Clanton makes a pass at Lisa Carew, getting into a fight with her father, who has promised Lisa to Johnny Coster; Lisa runs away from her home.

programme.desc: After discovering his wife has been kidnapped, a man recently released from prison learns that she will be released if he kills Clay Hollister.

programme.title: Man With the Gun

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection. (Western) - 1959

programme.desc: Henchmen in a helicopter chase a Utah prospector (Richard Basehart) seeking uranium with a professor and his daughter (Phyllis Kirk). (Western) - 1955

programme.desc: After finishing a stint as a cavalryman, Wayne Santley (James Brown) is looking forward to taking a job on his brother's ranch. While traveling to see his sibling, he helps entertainer Nora (Joan Staley) out of a sticky situation with an aggressive suitor, and promptly falls in love with her. But when he and Nora finally meet up with Wayne's brother, Brad (Gregg Palmer), they learn the ranch is just a front for a crime ring. Wayne is appalled, leading to a feud between the brothers. (Western) - 1961

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd. (Children, Drama) - 1960

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all. (Western) - 1959

programme.title: Man With the Gun
programme.desc: Sheridan City is out of control. The citizens are corrupt, the saloon is an immoral indulgence, and gunmen and greedy opportunists come and go as they please. With the town's lawman (Henry Hull) incapable of maintaining order, the town council brings in a hired gun, Clint Tollinger (Robert Mitchum), who has business of his own with the saloon madame (Jan Sterling). Tollinger sets about proving his reputation as a "town tamer" through his signature approach: eradicating violence with violence. (Western) - 1955

programme.desc: Bat travels to a Texas ranch to drive cattle for rancher Orin Dilts, but Orin stands accused of burning down the local land and the Grant family suspects Bat to be his hired gun. (Western) - 1961-02-23

programme.desc: A dude (Terence Hill) arrives from New England with books and a bicycle, ready to claim his father's rowdy ranch. (Western, Comedy) - 1972

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: A group of thieves rob a safe of $100,000 and plan to use the money to purchase some land near a proposed railway line. The crooks think they've gotten away with their crime, but they haven't figured on Sabata, a violent bounty hunter with no scruples and a strong desire for cash. He teams up with both his partner, Banjo, and a local bandit named Carrincha. Sabata's fast draw and quick wits make life hell for the thieves. (Western) - 1970

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son. (Western) - 1969

programme.title: Fury at Showdown
programme.desc: Reformed ex-convict Brock Mitchell (John Derek) completes a prison sentence for shooting a man in a desperate act of self-defense and travels to the ranch run by his brother, Tracy (Nick Adams). Now an outcast in his own hometown, Brock throws himself into raising animals and working the land. As the newly reconciled Mitchells make up for lost time, vicious gunslinger Miley Sutton (John Smith) finds himself on the payroll of the crooked brother of the man Brock killed. (Western) - 1957

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown. (Western) - 1949

programme.title: Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. While they are resting one night, their herd is robbed by a gang of thugs, leaving the cowboys stranded in the wilderness without their livelihood. Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again. (Western) - 1950

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted. (Horror) - 2004

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King. (Western) - 1948

Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers. (Western) - 1946

Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

programme.title: Phantoms
programme.desc: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: "The Hunted" is a suspense thriller about a tracker, Bonham (Tommy Lee Jones), who teams up with FBI agent Abby Durrell (Connie Nielsen) to hunt down a trained assassin Hallam (Benicio del Toro). With precision and skill, the predator remains one step ahead, and escapes into the city. (Action, Thriller) - 2003

programme.title: Flypaper
programme.desc: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2025

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E1 Day of the Daleks: Episode 1 Sir Reginald Styles, a diplomat with the best chance of averting a war between Russia and China, is almost killed by a mysterious guerrilla.The fighter then disappears with Jo and the Doctor - into a terrifying future Earth ruled by Daleks.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E2 Day of the Daleks: Episode 2 A captive of the guerrillas, the Doctor discovers they intend to change history. Jo is transported to the 22nd Century where she unwittingly gives vital information to the Daleks.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E3 Day of the Daleks: Episode 3 The Doctor arrives in a bleak future where Earth is ruled by the Daleks and mankind is enslaved. Rescuing Jo, the two escape but the brutish Ogrons are in pursuit.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E4 Day of the Daleks: Episode 4 The Controller betrays the Daleks and is exterminated. The Daleks travel back in time to the 20th Century to ensure that the peace conference fails.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E5 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 1 The planet Peladon is hoping to join the Galactic Federation. But King Peladon’s Chancellor has been murdered and it seems that the legendary royal beast, Aggedor is to blame.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E6 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 2 The work of the committee is hampered by sabotage, fear and suspicion. The Doctor knows the Ice Warriors of old and believes that they may be the guilty party.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E7 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 3 The Doctor is sentenced to a fight to the death in the pit with the King's champion, Grun. But the saboteur and killer is still at large.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E8 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 4 Hepesh, supported by the delegate from Arcturus, is revealed to be behind the attacks. Arcturus is killed but Hepesh escapes to rouse a rebellion against the King.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E9 The Sea Devils: Episode 1 The Doctor and Jo visit the Master who is held prisoner on an island. There they learn that several ships have recently been sunk in the area and the Doctor decides to investigate.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E10 The Sea Devils: Episode 2 The Doctor is eager to make peace between the Sea Devils and the humans but has discovered that the Master is up to his old tricks.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E11 The Sea Devils: Episode 3 Jo attempts to rescue the Doctor who is being held prisoner by the Master and Trenchard. The Master plans to summon the Sea Devils from beneath the waves.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E12 The Sea Devils: Episode 4 The Doctor attempts to persuade Captain Hart of the danger that the Master represents. Eager to make contact with the Sea Devils, the Doctor journey’s to the sea bed.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E13 The Sea Devils: Episode 5 The Doctor is captured by the Sea Devils and taken to their undersea base. There he tries to make peace with the creatures, but his efforts are thwarted by the Navy.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E14 The Sea Devils: Episode 6 The Sea Devils come to the surface and attack the Naval base. The Doctor is forced to create a machine that will awaken the creatures across the entire world.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E15 The Mutants: Episode 1 The Time Lords send the Doctor to a Skybase above the planet Solos in the 30th Century. The Marshal of the Skybase is determined to prevent Solos achieving independence from Earth.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E16 The Mutants: Episode 2 Fearing Jo has died in Solos's hostile environment, the Doctor is forced to work with the scientist, Jaeger, to make the planet's atmosphere breathable for humans.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E17 The Mutants: Episode 3 Ky opens the message box but cannot understand the ancient carved tablets inside. The Marshal seals the Doctor and his friends in the caves and prepares to gas them to death.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E18 The Mutants: Episode 4 The Doctor deduces the true meaning of the ancient carvings and must brave the intense radiation of the thaesium caves to retrieve a crystal.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E19 The Mutants: Episode 5 With Jo held prisoner, the Doctor is forced to work for the Marshal. The Earth Investigator’s ship prepares to dock at Skybase.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
programme.desc: S9 E20 The Mutants: Episode 6 Despite the Doctor's arguments, the Earth Investigator reinstates the Marshal as commander of Skybase. Bombarded by thaesium radiation, Ky begins an incredible transformation.

programme.title: Storm of Suspicion
programme.desc: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

programme.title: Hidden Habitats - Them & Us
programme.desc: The connections between humans and insects. (Nature, Documentary) - 2014-10-28

programme.title: Nature's Great Events - The Great Melt
programme.desc: The summer melt of Arctic ice provides opportunities for millions of animals, but grave dangers for others, including polar bears. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-02-11

programme.title: Creepshow
programme.desc: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

programme.title: Leprechaun
programme.desc: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold. (Horror, Comedy) - 1993

programme.title: Arachnophobia
programme.desc: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

programme.title: Pumpkinhead
programme.desc: An old woman summons a grotesque figure to punish teenage dirt bikers for killing a man's (Lance Henriksen) son. - 1988

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: Bitten by a rabid bat, a huge dog traps a Maine woman (Dee Wallace) and her young son (Danny Pintauro) in their Ford Pinto. - 1983

programme.title: An American Werewolf in London
programme.desc: A New York student (David Naughton) becomes the scourge of London after being bitten by a beast on the moors. - 1981

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A woman and her sons move to a coastal California town for a fresh start, unaware that it is full of teenage vampire punks. - 1987

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Celebrity guests discuss their current projects and the latest gossip hitting newsstands. (Talk, Entertainment, Comedy, Interview) - 2026-10-16

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out. (Horror, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1996

programme.title: The Return of the Living Dead
programme.desc: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

programme.title: Earth's Great Seasons - Autumn
programme.desc: With winter fast approaching, life has to get ready and that means feeding up while you can, fighting for the last chance to breed and rushing to grow up before the cold returns. (Nature, Documentary) - 2017-06-23

programme.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II - Macaque
programme.desc: High in the mountains of Morocco lives a descendant of a long line of macaque rulers who has been in charge of her troop for many winters - one of the longest recorded reigns of an alpha - but this year is likely to be her last. (Nature, Documentary) - 2025-12-07

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Teenage brothers Michael (Jason Patric) and Sam (Corey Haim) move with their mother (Dianne Wiest) to a small town in northern California. While the younger Sam meets a pair of kindred spirits in geeky comic-book nerds Edward (Corey Feldman) and Alan (Jamison Newlander), the angst-ridden Michael soon falls for Star (Jami Gertz) -- who turns out to be in thrall to David (Kiefer Sutherland), leader of a local gang of vampires. Sam and his new friends must save Michael and Star from the undead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1987

programme.title: The Price Is Right

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - The Roman House-Space and Decoration
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Why Study Battles? What Is War?
programme.desc: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - The Problem of Warfare's Origins
programme.desc: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare
programme.desc: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms
programme.desc: Evidence of warfare in Ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh
programme.desc: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Palaces Past and Present
programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods
programme.desc: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals and how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King
programme.desc: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe
programme.desc: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece
programme.desc: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Rome-A Spectacular Civilization
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Power, Conquest, and Romanization
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Triumphal Processions-Victory Parades
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Imperial Palaces
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Cameroon's Mountain of Greatness
programme.desc: Explorers can begin their Cameroon tour with a hike across the country's most impressive mountain.

programme.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Welcome to Britain
programme.desc: Why Great Britain offers so much as a travel destination; thousand-year-old castles and cathedrals; contemporary art museums and scenic hikes; a look at the scope of all Britain has to offer, along with a few unique ideas.

programme.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Prehistoric Britain
programme.desc: The beginning of Great Britain's history 5,000 years ago; a mysterious ancient people whose only vestiges are earthworks and stone circles; the massive popularity of Stonehenge; visiting other ancient ruins such as Avebury or Maiden Castle.

programme.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Roman Britain
programme.desc: The Roman conquest; how the Romans invaded Great Britain and spread their territory; Hadrian's Wall marking the edge of the empire; the Roman impact on Great Britain, from the city of Bath to the island's long and straight roads.

programme.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Anglo-Saxon and Viking Britain
programme.desc: How a number of Germanic tribes stepped in to fill the power vacuum left after the Romans left Britain; exploring the Anglo-Saxon conquests; the Viking attacks in the Middle Ages; Offa's Dyke and the monastery of Lindisfarne.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.

programme.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
programme.desc: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map.

programme.title: Worth the Hype - Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

programme.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen.

programme.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Hidden Escapes
programme.desc: The team discovers hidden retreats in Canada, Iceland, Sweden and the U.K., from sunken hotels to retreats surrounded by lava fields and a compound with military history.

programme.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Extreme Escapes
programme.desc: There are unusual hotels ranging from jungle retreats to converted caves.

programme.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Hidden Retreats
programme.desc: Uncovering truly remarkable and hidden retreats in Canada, Iceland, Sweden and the UK; from underwater sunken hotels to retreats surrounded by lava fields.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Getting to the Roots
programme.desc: The chefs and owners of Xokol restaurant in Guadalajara reconnect with their roots; chef Marin creates a drink and dessert inspired by his grandmother; chef Francisco Migoya makes a dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Food Meets Art
programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
programme.desc: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
programme.desc: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
programme.desc: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
programme.desc: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
programme.desc: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

programme.desc: S03 E16 Aliens and the Creation of Man Unexplained advances in human evolution point to the work of interstellar beings.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 2
programme.desc: Mahlers Auferstehungssinfonie, komponiert zwischen 1888 und 1894, ist ein monumentales Werk in fünf Sätzen, das Themen wie Tod und Auferstehung erforscht.

programme.title: Im Atelier des Künstlers
programme.desc: In dieser Serie spielt der Pianist Philippe Cassard in einer Meisterklasse Werke von Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Tschaikowski - Violinkonzert, op. 35
programme.desc: Simone Lamsma spielt mit dem London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Gianandrea Noseda Pjotr Tschaikowskis Violinkonzert in D-Dur. Bei diesem Konzert aus der Londoner Barbican Hall entfacht Lamsma ein virtuoses Feuer.

programme.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, op. 16
programme.desc: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Schwartz Schumanns Werk "Kreisleriana, Op. 16". Schumann behauptete, dass er diese Komposition von 1838 in nur vier Tagen niederschrieb. Er widmete sie Frédéric Chopin, seinem Zeitgenossen.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: Die Pianistin Martha Argerich spielt mit vielen Stars der klassischen Musik Ravels "Ma mère l'Oye". Das Konzert wird zugunsten des Erasmus-Fonds für medizinische Intensivpflegeforschung organisiert und dem Cellisten Aleksandr Khramouchin gewidmet.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 9
programme.desc: Mahlers 9. Symphonie besticht durch ihre tiefgreifende emotionale Tiefe und Verletzlichkeit, insbesondere durch das atemberaubend schöne und spirituell nachhallende Adagio.

programme.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf
programme.desc: Das weltberühmte sinfonische Märchen von Sergej Prokofjew wird in einer neuen Interpretation präsentiert. Der Dirigent erzählt die Geschichte auf seine Art und wird dabei vom Britten-Pears Orchester musikalisch unterstützt.

programme.title: Romeo und Julia
programme.desc: Sergeis Ballett "Romeo und Julia" basiert auf Shakespeares gleichnamigem Theaterstück. Prokofjew verarbeitete Auszüge daraus auch zu drei Orchestersuiten und einer Klavierfassung. In dieser Version gehen starke Bilder fließend ineinander über.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Klavierquartette aus Kanada
programme.desc: Das Ensemble Canada zollt der Diversität Kanadas aus der Perspektive seiner Einwohner Tribut.

programme.title: Mozart - Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 & Sinfonie Nr. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello dirigiert das Orchester des Teatro Comunale di Bologna in einem Konzert. Es wird mit der Ouvertüre aus Mozarts beliebter Oper "Die Zauberflöte" eröffnet. Es folgt das Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 in C-Dur, mit Maurizio Baglini als Solist.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26".

programme.title: Debussy, La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussys sinfonische Skizzen für Orchester beschwören das Meer in seiner vielfältigen Gestalt herauf. Dieses Konzert in der Kölner Philharmonie wird vom Chicago Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Daniel Barenboim gespielt.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
programme.desc: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Beethoven - Klavierkonzert Nr. 1
programme.desc: Martha Argerich spielt Ludwig van Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 und die Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur.

programme.title: Chopin - Klavierkonzert Nr. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 2, Op. 21. Der Solist ist Evgeny Kissin. Dieses Konzert war Teil der Feierlichkeiten anlässlich des 200. Geburtstags von Chopin.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

programme.title: Beethoven - Sinfonien und Klavierkonzert Nr. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leitet sein Budapest Festival Orchester in einem Konzertprogramm, das der Musik von Ludwig van Beethoven gewidmet ist. Das Programm beginnt mit der Symphonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, Op. 21 und Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur, Op. 58.

programme.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur.

programme.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik.
